scope: Unweighted nominal acceptance, for physics injection. 3D Bayesian phi_h in the copy of fits/unweighted/nominal/nominal/fit_copy.root, Q2-y 1-17. RC_Bayesian, BC_RC_Bayesian, Bin, and 5D were absent and were not created. The refined spline nominal was not copied onto these histograms. No publication. The source file and the shared Phi_h guides were not edited.
start_mode: manual. start=auto: the 3D spline B windows selected by these histograms have median width 0.0153 and 428 of 452 are narrower than 0.05, and the C windows are narrower, so they can pin a fit. The run-local guide started as Phi_h_Fit_Parameters_Initialize.py. --use_spline_init was not passed.
changed: Pass 1 used the manual baseline on all 452 histograms. It made 27 histograms worse because the manual start or the second fit pass left the cosine those points support. The worst was (3, 16), reduced chi-squared 1.435 to 16.216, with B driven from -0.184 to -0.037. (1, 4) went from 2.961 to 3.389 because the manual C window excludes C=0.023. (1, 22) went from 1.025 to 1.426. Pass 2 put those 27 starts on the stored cosine, opened the limits, and also moved five histograms that were still off their own unconstrained cosine: (10, 9) 2.118 to 1.858, (2, 14) 3.343 to 3.101, (4, 29) 2.453 to 2.264, (7, 35) 1.953 to 1.764, and (17, 2) 1.311 to 1.182. Refit Q2-y 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, and 17. Q2-y 6 and 8 were not refit and are unchanged. JSON still has 452. No retained bin is worse than the stored fit. (1, 8) stays at B=0.021181, statistical error 0.015724, C about 0, chi-squared 19.957, NDF 13, phi 60-300, 16 bins inside the TF1 range.
left_bins: No 5D family is in this file. Bins were not pulled toward the refined spline nominal. (1, 8) is not the spline B=-0.125 and is not the pinned acceptance-variation value -0.045. Its free cosine is B=-0.0015 with error 0.030 and C=-0.016 with error 0.019, chi-squared 19.167 against 19.957, so the histogram does not require the limit to be opened. The same holds for (5, 7) and (8, 30). (13, 10) keeps B=-0.358 because the points support that modulation. Collapsed parameter errors that remain are a stability note, not a smaller systematic uncertainty: (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_17) C, (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_8) C, (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_9) B, (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_9) C, (Q2_y_Bin_5)-(z_pT_Bin_7) C, (Q2_y_Bin_8)-(z_pT_Bin_30) C.
unresolved: The remaining high chi-squared is the histogram shape. The retained cosine already matches an unconstrained fit, so another guide change would not help. (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_32) 5.918 (chi2 124.285, NDF 21.0); (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_7) 5.339 (chi2 112.114, NDF 21.0); (Q2_y_Bin_12)-(z_pT_Bin_24) 4.421 (chi2 66.312, NDF 15.0); (Q2_y_Bin_13)-(z_pT_Bin_10) 4.325 (chi2 90.827, NDF 21.0). (1, 8) is not unresolved as a guide miss. No empty histograms. No range mismatches.
overlay: overlays/acceptance_final.png is the retained curve. overlays/acceptance_review.png draws the stored curve in blue and the retained curve in red on the same filled phi window.
why_retained: Pass 2 is kept because the 27 manual-pass regressions returned to the cosine those histograms support, and the five opened bins have lower chi-squared than the stored fit without leaving that histogram's own cosine. No histogram is worse than the stored fit. (1, 8) was not replaced by the spline nominal.
